title: Inbound Lead Slack Alert
summary: Score every form submission that hits a webhook and post it to Slack, flagging hot leads.

secrets.name: INBOUND_HMAC_SECRET
secrets.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret your form tool uses to sign webhook bodies.

secrets.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Slack bot token with the `chat:write` scope.

secrets.name: SLACK_LEADS_CHANNEL
secrets.description: Channel id or name to post leads to, for example `#leads`.

setup: Add the three secrets above and invite the Slack bot to the channel.
Publish the playbook and point your form tool's webhook at the URL shown in Studio.
Submit a test form and watch the run.
